name: norminvoice-monorepo
description: NormInvoice — Production EU E-Invoice Bridge & Dual Validator (ZUGFeRD 2.3 / Factur-X 1.07 / XRechnung 3.0.2)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @norminvoice/einvoice-core build && pnpm --filter @norminvoice/db build && pnpm --filter @norminvoice/sdk build && pnpm --filter @norminvoice/worker build && pnpm --filter @norminvoice/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @norminvoice/einvoice-core test && pnpm --filter @norminvoice/db test && pnpm --filter @norminvoice/sdk test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @norminvoice/einvoice-core build && pnpm --filter @norminvoice/db build && pnpm --filter @norminvoice/sdk build && pnpm -r typecheck
